CONTINUE preserves the PREFREEZE transaction and keeps promotion gated on independent audit PASS.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: All six scientific lanes are mid-flight on unfinished PREFREEZE experiments, each carrying a portfolio mandate from the previous direction pulse. The governing fact remains the one established in research/portfolio/PROGRAM_AUDIT_GLOBAL_2026-10-10.md: the factory produces evidence but no validated external-agent product, and the near-term critical path is exactly three blockers - B1 a shipped, independently promoted parameterized carrier (src/spider/kernel.py still has no distill_parameterized and a 0.5/0.8 confidence mismatch), B2 a multi-step task bank whose cold/retrieval baselines are NOT at a 1.0 ceiling, and B3 a same-model endpoint that can actually drive a minimal Web-agent task. I checked the accepted Codex state against the global audit and confirm the three flagship claims (C-PARAM-INHERIT, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY, C-LLM-INHERIT) must NOT receive a full four-arm execution now: readiness condition (1) fails (no shipped carrier; EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064 proved the path only on an experimental carrier), condition (2) fails (EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440 and EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064 both hit the 1.0 correctness ceiling), and condition (3) is unresolved (EXP-INTEL-37982024058 got 0/5 and 0/5 on local 3B/7B). The prior pulse's allocation already implements the correct response: Product is installing the audited carrier (B1), Runtime is attempting the non-ceiling asymmetric-discovery task-bank certificate (B2), and Intel is separating prompt-underspecification from model incapability on the minimal capability bar (B3). For the three non-critical lanes the question is whether their capped, predeclared-decision-value bets still beat the alternatives; they do. Physics has its strongest recent positive (S1_STATIONARY, audit PASS, producer_claim_supported=true, stationarity skill 0.3196 nats, perm p=9.999e-05, CLASS_PERSISTENCE 1.0) but under a single-vantage, 1800 s right-censored scope, and the single most decision-relevant bound left is vantage transfer, because a vantage-robust intrinsic classifier licenses ONE shared denylist while a vantage-specific one does not. Graph has pivoted off the transport-coupled four-anchor C-FRESHNESS loop (which the global audit recommended PARK) onto C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE under a materially repaired v2 design that fixes the three prior failures: joint intent/goal authorship, a non-distinct reference arm, and unsatisfiable control literals. Frontier holds a genuinely architectural question - whether shortest-path hop is a real acquisition-cost barrier or fresh-instance acquisition is constant-cost via site-native discovery - on a credential-free, K<=3-GET, capped substrate, after its v1 was correctly BLOCKED for an empty sampling frame (0 seeds, 0 DEEP items, 0 hosts) and no pre-freeze certificate. No lane is idle or failed-before-freeze-without-a-plan, so no PARK or TERMINATE is justified this cycle; the honest decision is CONTINUE on all six, with two hard design-contract-v2 guards I am making explicit: Physics must pre-freeze-certify that a second independent egress actually exists and record a bounded operational blocker instead of substituting a fifth single-vantage run, and Runtime/Frontier must satisfy their arithmetically-checkable pre-freeze certificates (dynamic range; DEEP-item attainability) before freezing anything. Local-attractor flags on graph, physics and runtime were treated as diagnostics, not quotas; in each case the cognitive reset confirmed the inherited direction over the fresh-look alternative on merits.
